content:
Hello,

I encountered some behaviors I didn't understand when experimenting with Async, specifically that operations in an Async produced by Async.concurrently can continue after the monad has invoked its continuation.

I'm new to Lean and was hesitant to create another online account so I opened an issue first (https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/issues/13829).
But it seems like Zulip may be a better place to ask about it. After some investigation, there doesn't appear to be a bug but I was wondering what other's thoughts are about whether there should be design or documentation changes.

I may not respond very quickly, by the way (which is partly why I was more comfortable with GitHub).

Thank-you,
Bernard Llanos
